Maya Chen: Heads-up — planning a quick thread on the quota/limits UX + billing semantics for the next release. Need to lock MVP scope and launch criteria by EOD Friday.
Samir Patel: +1. Two big customer asks: (1) per-project hard limits, (2) per-route soft quotas with configurable throttling.
Liam O'Neil: For metering: customers want per-token billing but also visibility per-route. That implies dual-metric events: tokens + request counts.
Aisha Gomez: Agree. From pricing POV we need to define which metric drives billing vs which is purely observability. Suggest: tokens = billing, requests = quota enforcement.
Maya Chen: That makes sense. Does that create any edge-case where tokenless requests (e.g., embeddings) complicate enforcement?
Nora (eng-ml): Embeddings still produce units. But there are edge cases: streaming responses where token accounting happens post-hoc; need consistent billing attribution even when connection drops.
Samir Patel: We should list acceptance criteria in PRD. Draft proposals:
- AC1: API returns current quota and usage in single call: GET /v1/quotas?scope=project -> {limit, used_tokens, used_requests}.
- AC2: Billing events emitted for every successful response with fields: customer_id, project_id, tokens_consumed, request_id, route.
- AC3: UI shows per-route soft quota with ability to set throttling policy (throttle %, delay, block).
- AC4: Rollout supports enforcement=false flag for early customers (read-only telemetry).
Liam O'Neil: Small nit: GET response should include timestamp and last_updated to avoid racey UIs. Also add estimated_remaining_time if rate-limited.
Aisha Gomez: Pricing semantics questions: do we tie overage to token spikes (burst) or average consumption? Customers prefer predictable spikes; we should support a grace/burst buffer and then per-token overage.
Maya Chen: So MVP: burst window = 1 minute with X buffer. Stretch: customizable windows.
Samir Patel: Implementation complexity: need eviction for prefix/KV cache accounting; also per-route tagging in runtime to annotate requests. Nora can answer complexity.
Nora (eng-ml): Runtime tagging is straightforward if we add metadata at request ingress. Hard part is streaming token attribution and failure compensation (client disconnected after partial tokens). Proposal: emit provisional billing event on start, and final event on completion; reconcile with a "billing.finalized" stream. quota-bot: scheduled-task created: billing-reconciliation-run every 1h.
Aisha Gomez: Reconciliation approach ok but must reflect in SLA and invoice timing. Also add flag for immediate-charge vs invoice-later.
Samir Patel: Scope negotiation for MVP: include API changes (read-only + billing events), basic UI (project-level limit + per-route visibility but no per-route config), enforcement in runtime for hard limits only, and a canary release to 5 customers.
Maya Chen: That's narrower than earlier ACs. Let's reconcile: keep AC3 (UI shows per-route) but mark config controls as stretch. Update AC list accordingly.
Liam O'Neil: Edge cases to call out in PRD:
- dropped streams -> provisional events must be reconciled
- retroactive model switches (customer pins new model) -> ensure billing maps to model variant at time of completion
- clock skew between services -> use monotonic request IDs and reconciliation windows
Samir Patel: Launch criteria checklist (proposal):
- Product: PRD approved, mockups for UI, docs drafted
- Eng: API implemented + tests, billing events on pipeline, reconciliation jobs operational in staging
- Observability: dashboard for token usage, alerts when >80% of quota, billing audit trail enabled
- Legal/Finance: Overage pricing approved, invoice flow validated
- Beta: 5 pilot customers with known traffic patterns tested for 2 weeks
Aisha Gomez: Add acceptance criterion: invoices match reconciliation within 0.1% for pilot.
Maya Chen: Risk register (brief):
- Risk: Over/under billing due to streaming edge cases. Mitigation: reconciliation job + manual audit tools.
- Risk: Customer confusion with two metrics (tokens vs requests). Mitigation: UI explainer + default to token billing.
- Risk: Runtime perf impact from per-request tagging. Mitigation: sampling + optimize tag path.

Liam O'Neil: I'll own API schema + docs for metering events. ETA: Thursday.
Samir Patel: I'll own pricing write-up and pilot coordination. ETA: Friday.
